About Tamara

Delivering for Ward 4.
Eight years of results.

Eight years ago, I pledged to always answer every call, show up, and address the issues for the residents of Hilton Head Island. I vowed to make municipal government work for you, to protect our unique environment, and to put residents first—always. Today, the results are clear: I have delivered.

This is what proven conservative leadership looks like: less tax burden, safer streets, protected green space, and unmatched fiscal stability. I'm humbly asking for your vote on November 3, 2026 to continue what we've started and deliver results for four more years.

Integrity · Dedication · Honesty Trusted Leadership That Delivers Ward 4 Resident, Eight Years of Service

— Tamara Becker

01

Fiscal responsibility that works

A unanimous AAA credit rating from all three major rating agencies, increased reserves in every municipal fund category, and property tax rates lowered twice.

02

Preserving our island's character

Over 120 acres of open space preserved, dozens of Land Management Ordinance (LMO) amendments passed, and high-density growth stopped to protect what makes Hilton Head special.

03

Proactive public safety

Initiated and funded an island-wide public safety assessment, launched William Hilton Parkway (WHP) corridor infrastructure plans, and upgraded multi-modal pathways for drivers, bicyclists, and pedestrians.

Together we will continue delivering results and building lasting success.

Tamara Becker

Community Endorsements

You're not my council representative, I live in Ashton Cove. Although we had a stormwater agreement with the town, it was never enacted. Once elected to my POA board, you were my first phone call, and you answered on the second ring.

From that moment, you not only set up meetings with the town, the stormwater division, but attended every one. One year later, Ashton Cove has a stormwater design. You didn't need to go the extra mile, but you did.

I cannot thank you enough for solving a huge problem in a community you don't even represent.

MF

Megan Fitzpatrick

Ashton Cove Resident

In the fight to protect our South Carolina values and fight for families, the partnership between state and local officials couldn't be more important. Councilwoman Becker has proven she will steward taxpayer money well and be a strong partner.

We are happy to endorse her for reelection and keep fighting for Hilton Head Island families.

MR

Senator Mike Reichenbach

South Carolina State Senate

01

Pillar 01

Fiscal Conservatism

Responsible budgeting and smart spending that protects taxpayers and ensures long-term financial stability for our town.

  • Unanimous AAA credit rating from all three major rating agencies
  • Increased reserves in ALL municipal fund categories
  • Property tax rates lowered—twice
02

Pillar 02

Island Preservation

Protecting Hilton Head's natural beauty, character, and quality of life while respecting tourism's role in our economy.

  • 120+ acres of open space preserved to stop overdevelopment
  • Dozens of Land Management Ordinance (LMO) amendments passed
  • Stopped high-density growth that threatens island character
03

Pillar 03

Proactive Public Safety

Safer streets and smarter infrastructure for everyone who lives on, works on, and visits Hilton Head Island.

  • Island-wide public safety conditions assessment—initiated and funded
  • William Hilton Parkway (WHP) corridor infrastructure plans
  • Multi-modal pathway upgrades for drivers, bicyclists, and pedestrians
04

Pillar 04

Balanced Island Life

Neighborhood-first policies that put residents at the center of every decision, with tourism paying its own way.

  • Neighborhood First policies in every council decision
  • Tourism pays its own way—visitors help fund the services they use
  • Elevated quality of life for residents, and an email always open at tammy4ward4@gmail.com
